title: Supreme Tadpole
summary: Transforms its user into a full mind flayer.

fields.Use: In the final Act Three Astral Plane sequence, full transformation is available to the player character, Karlach or Orpheus. It does not require prior partial transformation. The Supreme Tadpole is consumed to become a mind flayer.
fields.Acquisition: Given by the Emperor near the end of Act Three.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
